questions.question: If 19 July 2000 is Wednesday, then what will be the day of the week on 14 June 2009?
questions.questionHtml: If 19 July 2000 is Wednesday, then what will be the day of the week on 14 June 2009?
questions.solution:
Given: 19 July 2000 was Wednesday.

Now,

2000 to 2009 = 9 Years (7 Ordinary Years and 2 Leap Years).

And, In 9 Years = 2 Leap Years and 7 Ordinary Years.

So, 2 Leap Years have 4 odd days,

And, 7 Ordinary Years have 7 odd days.

Total odd days = 4 + 7 = 11.

11 odd days → 11/7 = 1 week and 4 odd days.

then, 19 July 2009 will be Wednesday + 4 = Sunday.

Now, the number of days between 14 June 2009 to 19 July 2009

= 16 (June) + 19 (July) = 35 days.

= 35 days → 35/7 = 5 weeks and 0 odd days.

So, 14 June 2009 will be Sunday - 0 = Sunday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question: If 20 June of a particular year falls on the 6th day after Tuesday, then what will be the day on 11 August of the same year?
questions.questionHtml: If 20 June of a particular year falls on the 6th day after Tuesday, then what will be the day on 11 August of the same year?
questions.solution:
6th day after Tuesday is Monday, so day on 20 June will be Monday.

Number of days between 20 June to 11 August = (10 + 31 + 11) = 52

52 when divided by 7, leaves 3 as remainder.

Monday + 3 = Thursday

So, the day on 11 August of the same year will be Thursday.

Hence, ‘Thursday’ is the correct answer.

Now,

And, In 8 Years = 2 Leap years and 6 Ordinary Years.

So, 2 Leap Years have 4 odd days,

And, 6 Ordinary Years have 6 odd days.

Total odd days = 4 + 6 = 10.

10 odd days → 10/7 = 1 week and 3 odd days.

then, 18 January 2021 will be Friday + 3 = Monday.

Now, the number of days between 18 January 2021 to 19 December 2021

= 13(January) + 28(February) + 31(March) + 30(April) + 31(May) + 30(June) + 31(July) + 31(August) + 30(September) + 31(October) + 30(November) + 19(December) = 335 days.

= 335 days → 335/7 = 47 weeks and 6 odd day.

So, 19 December 2021 will be Monday + 6 = Sunday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: If 19 July 2000 is Wednesday, then what will be the day of the week on 17 March 2015?
questions.questionHtml: If 19 July 2000 is Wednesday, then what will be the day of the week on 17 March 2015?
questions.solution:
Given: 19 July 2000 was Wednesday.

Now,

2000 to 2015 = 15 Years (12 Ordinary Years and 3 Leap Years).

So, 3 Leap Years have 6 odd days,

And, 12 Ordinary Years have 12 odd days.

Total odd days = 6 + 12 = 18.

18 odd days → 18/7 = 2 weeks and 4 odd days.

then, 19 July 2015 will be Wednesday + 4 = Sunday.

Now, the number of days between 17 March 2015 to 19 July 2015

= 14(March) + 30(Apr) + 31(May) + 30(June) + 19(July) = 124 days.

= 124 days → 124/7 = 17 weeks and 5 odd days.

So, 17 March 2015 will be Sunday - 5 = Tuesday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

If it was Friday three days ago → Today is Monday.

150 days ago from today, i.e 21 weeks + 3 odd days

⇒ Monday - 3 = Friday

hence, the correct answer is "Friday".

Mistake Points The question is asks to find the day before 150 days, so subtract the odd day from today.

questions.question: If the year is NOT a leap year, then how is the last day of the year and first day of the same year related?
questions.questionHtml: If the year is NOT a leap year, then how is the last day of the year and first day of the same year related?

options.text: First day is Sunday, last day is Friday
options.html: First day is Sunday, last day is Friday

options.text: First day is Sunday, last day is Saturday
options.html: First day is Sunday, last day is Saturday

options.text: First day is Tuesday, last day is Saturday
options.html: First day is Tuesday, last day is Saturday

questions.solution:
In a non-leap year, there are 365 days, which equals 52 weeks and 1

additional day. This means the last day of the year will be the same day of

the week as the first day of the year. Therefore, the first and last days of

the year are the same.

questions.question: If 14 May 1953 is Thursday, then what will be the day of the week on 27 July 1963?
questions.questionHtml: If 14 May 1953 is Thursday, then what will be the day of the week on 27 July 1963?
questions.solution:
Given:

14 May 1953 = Thursday

As we know:

Leap Year 2 Odd days
Normal Year 1 Odd day

14 May 1953 = Thursday

14 May 1954 = Thursday + 1 = Friday

14 May 1955 = Friday + 1 = Saturday

14 May 1956 = Saturday + 2 = Monday

14 May 1957 = Monday + 1 = Tuesday

14 May 1958 = Tuesday + 1 = Wednesday

14 May 1959 = Wednesday + 1 = Thursday

14 May 1960 = Thursday + 2 = Saturday

14 May 1961 = Saturday + 1 = Sunday

14 May 1962 = Sunday + 1 = Monday

14 May 1963 = Monday + 1 = Tuesday

Odd days from 14 May 1963 to 27 July 1963 = [May(17) + June (30) + July(27)] = (74 ÷ 7) = 4 Odd days

27 July 1963 = Tuesday + 4 = Saturday

27 July 1963 → Saturday

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".

So, 4 Leap Years have 8 odd days,

And, 11 Ordinary Years have 11 odd days.

19 odd days → 19/7 = 2 weeks and 5 odd days.

then, 19 February 2019 will be Thursday + 5 = Tuesday.

Now, the number of days between 19 February 2019 to 2 March 2019

= 9(February) + 2(March) = 11 days.

= 11 days → 11/7 = 1 week and 4 odd days.

So, 2 March 2019 will be Tuesday + 4 = Saturday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

Year Period Calculation Odd days

1970 - 2077 Full years (6 Ordinary years + 2 Leap years) (1 odd day × 6 Ordinary years) + (2 odd days × 2 Leap years) = 10 odd days 10 ÷ 7 = 3

Total odd days (8 ÷ 7) = 1

Now, 50 days ago from today.

questions.question: If 18th October 2006 was Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 17th October 2000?
questions.questionHtml: If 18th October 2006 was Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 17th October 2000?
questions.solution:
TRICK:

To find the day on the same date of the same month:

In case of an ordinary year - Given day + 1 day

In case of a leap year - Given day + 2 days

(Here, we consider the month of February as there are 29 days)

Now, According to question,

we have to go back in time to find the day on the given date and month.

Given: 18 October 2006 ⇒ Wednesday

18 October 2005 ⇒  Wednesday - 1 = Tuesday

18 October 2004 ⇒  Tuesday - 1 days = Monday

18 October 2003 ⇒  Monday - 2 days = Saturday 

(The month of February lies between 18 October 2003 and 18 October 2004, which is a leap year)

18 October 2002 ⇒  Saturday - 1 day = Friday

18 October 2001 ⇒  Friday - 1 day = Thursday

18 October 2000 ⇒  Thursday - 1 = Wednesday

17 October 2000 ⇒ Wednesday - 1 day = Tuesday

(Here, we've subtracted 1 day because the month of February is before 17 October 2000)

Alternate Method:

18 October 2006 from 17 October 2000 there are = 5 ordinary and 1 leap year  

No. of days that should be subtracted from Wednesday = 5  for ordinary year + 2 for leap year

18 October 2000 = Wednesday - 7 days = Wednesday 

17 October 2000 = Wednesday - 1 = Tuesday

Hence, Tuesday is correct.

So, 1 Leap Year has 2 odd days,

And, 4 Ordinary Years have 4 odd days.

Total odd days = 2 + 4 = 6.

6 odd days → 6/7 = 0 weeks and 6 odd days.

then, 15 August 2011 will be Tuesday + 6 = Monday.

Now, the number of days between 15 August 2011 to 19 February 2012

= 16(August) + 30(September) + 31(October) + 30(November) + 31(December) + 31(January) + 19(February) = 188 days.

= 188 days → 188/7 = 26 weeks and 6 odd days.

So, 19 February 2012 will be Monday + 6 = Sunday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.questionHtml: If 15 December 2006 is a Friday, then what will the day of the week on 13 October 2009?
questions.solution:
To determine the day of the week for 13 October 2009, start from 15

December 2006, which is a Friday. From 2006 to 2009, there are 2

ordinary years and 1 leap year, totaling 4 odd days. Adding 4 days to

Friday results in Tuesday. Therefore, 13 October 2009 is a Tuesday.

questions.question: What day of the week will be on 1st January 2033?
questions.questionHtml: What day of the week will be on 1st January 2033?
questions.solution:
⇒ Since 2032 is a leap year, so the number of odd days in 2032 is 2.

⇒ The number of odd days from 31st December 2032 to 1st January 2033 is 1.

⇒ 1st January 2033 is Saturday.

questions.question: If 11 August 2004 is Wednesday, then what will be the day of the week on 11 February 2006?
questions.questionHtml: If 11 August 2004 is Wednesday, then what will be the day of the week on 11 February 2006?
questions.solution:
Given: 11 August 2004 was Wednesday.

Then, 11 August 2005 was Wednesday + 1 = Thursday.

Now, from 11 August 2005 to 11 February 2006

= 20(Aug) + 30(Sept) + 31(Oct) + 30(Nov) + 31(Dec) + 31(Jan) + 11(Feb)

= 184 days.

And, Total odd days in 184 days = 184/7 = 26 weeks and 2 odd days.

So, 11 February 2006 will be → Thursday + 2 = Saturday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question: If 25 March 1995 is a Saturday, then what will be the day of the week on 12 December 1997?
questions.questionHtml: If 25 March 1995 is a Saturday, then what will be the day of the week on 12 December 1997?
questions.solution:
⇒ There are 262 days from March 25, 1995 to December 12, 1997, which has a remainder of 3 when divided by 7.

⇒ It was Friday on December 12, 1997.

questions.question: If 2 March 2022 was a Wednesday, what day of the week was it on 2 March 2006?
questions.questionHtml: If 2 March 2022 was a Wednesday, what day of the week was it on 2 March 2006?
questions.solution: 2 March 2022 was a Wednesday. Then, 2022 - 2006 = 16 Years. In 16 Years = 12 normal years, 4 leap years. We know, normal year = 1 odd day, Leap year = 2 odd day. So, 12 + 8 = 20 odd days. So, 2 March 2006 = Wednesday - 6 = Thursday.

questions.question: If 31 December 2003 was a Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 7 March 2005?
questions.questionHtml: If 31 December 2003 was a Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 7 March 2005?
questions.solution:
31st Dec 2003 is Wednesday. Next, 1st Jan 2004 to 31st Dec 2004 = 2 odd days. So, 31st Dec 2004 will be Wednesday + 2 = Friday.

Now, in the year 2005, no of days = (31) Jan + (28) Feb + (7) Mar = 66 days = 9 weeks 3 days. So, 7th March 2005 = Friday + 3 = Monday

questions.question: If it is Wednesday on 13 September 2023, then what will be the day of the week on 30 August 2030?
questions.questionHtml: If it is Wednesday on 13 September 2023, then what will be the day of the week on 30 August 2030?
questions.solution:
Given: 13 September 2023 is Wednesday.

Now, 2023 to 2030 = 7 Years, In 7 years 2 Leap Year(2024, 2028), and 5 Ordinary Year.

Total odd days from 13 September 2023 to 13 September 2030 = (2 × 2) + (5 × 1) = 4 + 5 = 9 days.

And, 9 days = 1 week and 2 odd days.

So, 13 September 2030 will be Wednesday + 2 = Friday.

Now,

We need to subtract 14 days from 13 September 2030 to find the day on 30 August 2030.

And, 14 days = 2 week and 0 odd days.

Therefore, 30 August 2030 = Friday - 0 = Friday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: If 11 July 2020 was Monday, what will be 14 October 2028?
questions.questionHtml: If 11 July 2020 was Monday, what will be 14 October 2028?
questions.solution:
⇒ There are 304 days from 11 July 2020 to 14 October 2028.
⇒ 304 days divided by 7 days in a week has a remainder of 6.
⇒ 14 October 2028 is Monday.

⇒ The number of odd days from 19 September 1999 to 19 January 2001 is 6.

⇒ 19 January 2001 is Friday

questions.solution:
The number of odd days is zero in a century leap year (ie. 2000)

for 9 March 2002 = 1 odd day (2001) + 3 odd days (January 2002) + 2 odd days (9 days in March 2002) = 1 + 3 + 2 = 6 odd days 

6 Odd days indicate Saturday.

questions.question: If 17 April 1992 is Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 10 October 1993?
questions.questionHtml: If 17 April 1992 is Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 10 October 1993?
questions.solution:
Given: 17 April 1992 is Friday.

then, 17 April 1993 will be Friday + 1 = Saturday.

So, the number of days between 17 April 1993 to 10 October 1993

= 13(April) + 31(May) + 30(June) + 31(July) + 31(August) + 30(September) + 10(October)

= 176 days → 176/7 = 25 week and 1 odd day.

So, 10 October 1993 = Saturday + 1 = Sunday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

Mistake Points Yes, 1992 was a leap year but we have counted from 17th April that's why it is treated as normal year because 29th February is not counted in this year.

questions.question: If 19 July 2000 was a Wednesday, then what would be the day of the week on 15 June 2012?
questions.questionHtml: If 19 July 2000 was a Wednesday, then what would be the day of the week on 15 June 2012?
questions.solution:
Odd days:

A non-leap year has 365 days and a leap year has 366 days.

Non-leap year = 365 days or 52 weeks and 1 day. So, here the number of odd days is 1.

Leap year = 366 days or 52 weeks and 2 days So, here the number of odd days are 2.

Leap year between 2000 to 2012 = 2004, 2008 and 2012

And,

The non-leap year between 2000 and 2012 = 2001, 2002, 2003, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2009, 2010 and 2011

So, total number of odd day between 2000 and 2012 = 9 (Total Non- leap year) + 2 + 2 + 2 = 15 days = 1 odd day

Code of the day

Day

0

Sunday

1

Monday

2

Tuesday

3

Wednesday

4

Thursday

5

Friday

6

Saturday

 

19 July 2000 was a Wednesday

=> Day on 19 July 2012 = Wednesday + 15

= Wednesday + remainder of 15/7

= Wednesday + 1 (odd day) = Thursday

Therefore, 19 July 2012 = Thursday

Now,

15 June 2012 = 19 July 2012 – 34 days

= Thursday – 34

= Thursday – the remainder of 34/7

= Thursday – 6 (In reverse direction)

= Friday

Hence, 15 June 2012 was “Friday”.

questions.question: If 28 February 2020 was Friday, then what was the day of the week on 30 December 2015?
questions.questionHtml: If 28 February 2020 was Friday, then what was the day of the week on 30 December 2015?
questions.solution:
Since, 2019, 2018, and 2017 are ordinary years. All have only 1 odd day and, 2016 is a leap year. This will have 2 odd days.

Total days = 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 = 5.

So, 28 Feb 2016 = Friday - 5 = Sunday

Next, we will count the days of the remaining months as:

27 (Feb) + 31 (Jan) + 2 (Dec) = 60 = 8 weeks and 4 odd days.

30 Dec 2015 was Sunday - 4 = Wednesday.

questions.question: If it was Tuesday on 22 July 1969, then what will be the day of the week on 6 August 1985?
questions.questionHtml: If it was Tuesday on 22 July 1969, then what will be the day of the week on 6 August 1985?
questions.solution:
Given: 22 July 1969 is Tuesday.

Now, 1969 to 1985 = 16 Years.

In 16 years, 4 Leap year and 12 ordinary years.

Total odd days from 22 July 1969 to 22 July 1985 = (4 × 2) + (12 × 1) = 8 + 12 = 20 days.

And, 20 days = 20/7 = 2 week and 6 odd days.

So, 22 July 1985 was = Tuesday + 6 = Monday.

Now, 22 July 1985 to 6 August 1985 = 15 days, 15/7 = 2week and 1 odd day.

Therefore, 6 August 1985 = Monday + 1 = Tuesday.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".
